title: Practice: Approaching and moving off: под- and от-

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson before this one teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These sentences and their English translations were written by people on Tatoeba (tatoeba.org), shared under CC BY 2.0 FR. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: Who's taking the kids to school?
exercises.why: «от-»: отводить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Take it to a mechanic, and get it fixed.
exercises.why: «от-»: отнести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The dog came running to us.
exercises.why: «под-»: подбежать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Лодка ___ (отплыть) от берега и вскоре исчезла в тумане.
exercises.prompt: The boat floated away from the shore and soon disappeared into the fog.
exercises.why: «от-»: отплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от-»: отвозить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«под-»: подходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The ship sails for Honolulu tomorrow.
exercises.why: «от-»: отплывать. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Следующий поезд «Синкансэн» ___ (отходить) ровно в девять часов.
exercises.prompt: The next Shinkansen train leaves at just nine o'clock.
exercises.why: «от-»: отходить. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«под-»: подвести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Том ___ (подплыть) по-собачьи к неглубокой части бассейна.
exercises.prompt: Tom dog paddled toward the shallow end of the pool.
exercises.why: «под-»: подплыть. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от-»: отвести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: A gigantic bird came flying toward him.
exercises.why: «под-»: подлететь. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«от-»: отвезти. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: Tom raised his glass to his lips.
exercises.why: «под-»: поднести. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
